name: Himegami Manami
source:
A miko working at the town's shrine. Manami was born and raised in Kyoto, and she speaks in Kyoto dialect.
Unfussy and relaxed, she works hard at the shrine instead of her hospitalized grandfather.
She is a third-year at Kouryoukan Academy, however, because she has been busy with working at the shrine, she has been skipping a lot.
